classification.resume: The record is a press article from the Swiss Federal Archives covering Swiss pocket watch trade, tariffs, and correspondence regarding Japanese customs increases between 1904 and 1906. It documents economic relations and trade policy matters of the time. The article is part of the Swiss federal administration's holdings on foreign trade.
